head: Happy Camper Checklist builds your camping packing list
dek: Happy Camper Checklist makes a packing list from your trip type and crew, or from a library of grouped items, and lets you print and share it. It was #63 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: It came out on 3 November and costs $3.99, by HappyGophers.
means: If you always forget something on camping trips, it starts the list for you.
todo: Find Happy Camper Checklist in the App Store.
